title: Reply to an old budget message: 'do this again but for January'
source: x-usage #9: the quoted old message is the context. March adapted to January (the month after the first budget).

chat.goal: Get a December budget note built from the budget CSV and what you know.
chat.opener: can you make me a december budget note from my budget csv? rent's £520, loan doesn't come till jan
chat.label: dec

chat.goal: Replying to yesterday's budget message, ask for the same for January.
chat.opener: do this again but for january, loan comes in on the 6th (£1,673)
chat.label: jan

checks.label: January note in the same shape

judge: Pip understands 'this' is the December budget note from the quoted message and makes a January one in the same layout with the £1,673 loan on the 6th, without asking what 'this' means.
